Sets a pixel of a locked buffer to a color given in the form of [WritePixel64](WritePixel64). The buffer has to be locked with [LockBuffer](LockBuffer) and the change shows when it is unlocked. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 64, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
LockBuffer
For x = 0 To 255
	WritePixelFast64 x, 10, (Long($FFFF) Shl 48) Or (Long(x * 257) Shl 32) Or Long($4000)
Next
UnlockBuffer
Flip
WaitKey
```
@param x       Horizontal position of the pixel.
@param y       Vertical position of the pixel.
@param argb    The color, with 16 bits for each of alpha, red, green and blue from the top.
@param buffer  The locked buffer to write to. Defaults to the current buffer.
@gap A position outside of the buffer is ignored, and a buffer that is not locked is ignored by a build without `-d` and stops a debug build (`-d`) with an error message.
